expectations: Activates the prompt-library-for-startups skill, reads `references/prompt-library.md`, and opens `references/prompt-library/rag-chatbot-with-claude.md`
Quotes the full System Prompt verbatim and cites the canonical `source_url` from frontmatter
Offers the three host-context options (run / adapt / copy) without telling the user to paste into an external AI tool, and waits before executing
